notes: Phase 3 of pre-merge review fixes (H-4): Refactored createImagePanelHandlers to accept optional onRenderScheduled callback, replacing direct this._scheduleRender() calls. Follows the established callback injection pattern used by all other handler modules (createLayoutHandlers, createBackgroundHandlers, etc.). Updated createCollageMethods to wire the callback. Added 21 tests covering: callback firing on removeImage/clearAllImages/removeSelectedImage, missing callback guard, non-function callback types (null, {}, 0, ''), callback error resilience (state mutation succeeds even if callback throws), empty state edge cases, and DIP validation (handler works with plain objects). All 38 test files pass (1,530 total tests). World-review addressed concerns about non-function callback guards and callback error resilience by adding 8 additional tests.
